title: Frozen AF23 TypedLoop transfer to nonisomorphic shared-subproof, OR-goal and crossed-conjunction Horn grammars

model.checkpoints: Exact original AF23 fixed-final-update from source-pinned CI #43812708916
model.network_inputs: Same public 15 physical atoms, at most 14 Horn rules, known atoms, marked subgoals 6/13 and goal 14

cohorts.disjointness: Two public goal-concluding Horn rules in all families versus one conjunctive goal rule in original AF23. Different goal arity and root-dependency topologies.

family_definitions.shared_overcount: Goal subgoals share 2- or 3-rule productive prefix. Alternative direct-goal chain takes 7 or 8 actions; additive closure overcounts the productive shared prefix.
family_definitions.or_goal_competition: Two alternative single-premise rules conclude goal. One chain length 5/6, a second longer, with different dependencies.
family_definitions.crossed_conjunction: Goal can be concluded from a productive conjunctive branch sharing intermediates or a competing direct-goal chain with crossed prerequisite gates.

structural_gate.failure_policy: Abort before any model scoring. Any generator changes require an explicit dated amendment before scoring.

arms.neural_scoring: Reuse exact original AF23 model weights and Bellman score formula, with new host-legal successor graphs.
arms.symbolic_scoring: Reuse unchanged original AF24 symbolic algorithms. Shortest oracle restricted to scoring.
arms.proof_budget: Original shortest proof length +1 firing for provable, 2 decisions for unprovable
arms.stop_reporting: Report correct initial STOP on unprovable and premature STOP on provable separately
arms.compute_reporting: Actual neural forwards, symbolic rule examinations, BFS node expansions and same-runtime timing; no equivalence of distinct units.

primary_gate.name: frozen_neural_transfer_over_best_graph_aware
primary_gate.per_depth: VI2 success >= best symbolic success +10 percentage points, >=50% absolute, >=90% immediate STOP on unprovable, zero false accepted proofs
primary_gate.checkpoint_eligibility: All eight original AF23 source-bound checkpoints that pass original artifact hash and Torch/NumPy parity; no heldout selection
primary_gate.scope: Synthetic finite Horn proof DAGs, not autonomous Lean theorem proving.

audit.checkpoint: Verify original GitHub ZIP artifact digest and every member, original source signatures, Torch/NumPy parity
audit.proof: Independent BFS from public encoded physical incidence; replay every rule, STOP, proof budget, saved numeric backup and sampled Torch forwards
audit.retention: Save every per-episode record, per-seed audit, and independent aggregate
audit.original_results: Never rewrite original AF22, AF23, or AF24 scientific verdicts or results
